goal: Pick up the charger and plug it into the socket of the power strip so that it sits upright and fully inserted, then return the arms to their start pose.
instruction_templates: Plug the charger into the power strip.
success: All four conditions hold at the same time after one action (single stage):

Insertion depth: (top z of the socket's world bounding box) minus (lowest z of the charger's world bounding box) > 0.015 m, i.e. the bottom of the charger is more than 1.5 cm below the top of the socket's bbox.
Position: the charger root position's XY lies inside the footprint (convex hull of the rotated bbox, in XY) of the 'socket' bbox and the charger root z is above the socket bbox's bottom z.
Orientation: the charger's local +Y axis is within 10 deg (strict) of the world +Z (up) axis.

Both target arms back at origin: all target arms (left_arm and right_arm; the support arm is not counted) have their end-effector pose within 0.15 m on EACH axis (|dx|,|dy|,|dz| all <= 0.15 m) and within 20 degrees (quaternion angle) of the pose they had at the start of the episode (recorded after the scene settled).
evaluation: Single stage; all four conditions must hold simultaneously after the same action. The reward manager is evaluated only once per action (after the sim sub-steps of that action are finished), never between sub-steps. In each evaluation the FIRST pending stage of the check list is tested (every condition in it, all at that same moment; a condition that is a nested list is an OR); when it passes it is removed permanently (never re-verified later) and the next stage becomes pending; at most one stage is removed per action. Reward is 1.0 only when the check list is empty (and no query/trigger counter is violated); the episode is declared a success as soon as reward >= 0.999 after an action, and ends as a failure if the action counter reaches step_lim without that, or earlier if the environment is flagged failed (query counter exceeded, see below). No final_check list is registered by this task, so the final-check logic at step_lim adds nothing. There is no early failure condition; if never satisfied the episode fails at step_lim.
objects: charger: charger plug (Rigid, 1), table-frame x in [-0.45,-0.1] or [0.1,0.45], y in [-0.25,-0.1], random yaw up to +-30 deg
socket: power-strip socket (Rigid, 1), table-frame x in [-0.4,-0.15] or [0.15,0.4], y in [-0.15,-0.05], random yaw up to +-30 deg
end_requirements: Both target arms must be within 0.15 m per axis and 20 deg of their start end-effector pose at the moment the plug conditions hold (part of the single success stage), so the charger must remain inserted while the arms are brought home (or the arms must already be within the home tolerance, e.g. after release).
notes: Precision task: the socket is a free Rigid body (it can move/be knocked or pushed while plugging). The orientation test uses the charger's LOCAL Y axis ([0,1,0]) as 'up' (asset-specific convention; the charger's plug direction relative to local axes is not statically known). The insertion test uses axis-aligned world bounding boxes and the charger root point, so merely placing the charger on top of/inside the strip's bbox footprint with its bbox bottom 1.5 cm below the socket's bbox top is enough as far as the code is concerned. The socket and charger may be on the same or opposite sides of the table.
